run_f_gold_search: run f_gold to efficiently search for a target value x in an array where adjacent elements differ by at most 1
test_f_gold: test f_gold with multiple parameter sets to verify correct index or -1 return values
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses abs difference skipping to find target x in array arr of size n
review_f_gold_algorithm: review the f_gold algorithm that skips indices by abs(arr[i] - x) for efficient searching
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the TOFILL placeholder f_filled with a working implementation
